learning_outcomes.text: Describe detailed knowledge of important primary forming, forming processes, and generative manufacturing processes.
Master demanding tasks and demonstrate solutions from both technological and economic perspectives.
Classify the manufacturing processes required for the production of given example products into the sequence of a process chain.
Develop solutions for problems in manufacturing technology under aspects of sustainability.

syllabus_topics: Forming processes (process overview, material behavior, flow, formability, basics of calculation)
Introduction to new topics and critical questioning as well as plausibility check of energy transition scenarios
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is passing the written examination. Successful participation in the internship for the course is a prerequisite for taking the examination.
